run_collect_result_cli: run the cli to analyze test logs in a directory and generate a summary report
analyze_logs_with_loganalyzer: analyze test log files in a directory and return sorted test results with status and duration
determine_test_status_from_log: determine if a test passed failed or has no tests by scanning log content for markers
generate_summary_report_with_reportgener: generate a formatted summary report table and append it to an output file
extract_test_duration_from_log: extract the last test duration from log content and format it as hours minutes seconds
